subject: [PATCH v4 1/4] btrfs: split btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() into prealloc and commit phases

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch splits the btrfs_insert_delayed_dir_index() function into three separate functions: prealloc, commit, and free. The prealloc phase allocates memory for a delayed node and item, populates the item data, and inserts it into an rb-tree. The commit phase reserves metadata space and performs the actual insertion. If the allocation fails, the free helper is called to release the allocated resources. This refactoring allows callers to handle ENOMEM errors before modifying on-disk state.
